source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    1. All components are easy to plug and unplug. 
2. Check if device still be detect without error after plug cycle

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria: All components should be seated properly

deepseek_columns.ai_commands: Operator plug/unplug; agent may run mst/lspci after reseat.
deepseek_columns.ai_logs_output: Operator seating evidence plus device detection.

historical_reviews.deepseek: NO; correctly preserves physical boundary and suggests post-cycle detection, but lacks exact Mellanox path, traffic and recovery gates.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: MANUAL ONLY / IMPROVED; adds cable/endpoint mapping, production-impact approval, OOB, mechanical evidence and mst/lspci/link checks.

original_test_intent: Verify that the approved Mellanox cable/connector pair can be plugged and unplugged without abnormal resistance or damage, seats/latches correctly, and restores the expected device/link without errors after the cycle.
original_method: An operator identifies both endpoints, inspects and performs the approved physical cycle, judges seating/latch/connector condition and records it; automation captures Mellanox device/link/fabric and platform error state before and after reseating.
manual_activity: Plug/unplug, insertion force, latch engagement and seating are the tested properties. Software can corroborate recovery but cannot perform or judge the mechanical core.
required_inputs: Cable part/serial/type and both physical ports/endpoints
Whether link carries management, storage, fabric or production traffic
Connector/latch/orientation service instruction and cycle count
Expected mst/PCIe/netdev/fabric detection and link parameters
Maintenance approval, OOB and recovery/fallback path
safety_requirements: Do not interrupt production, storage, management or active fabric without explicit plan.
Verify both endpoints and traffic state before touching the cable.
Use correct release/latch/orientation; stop on bent pins, excessive force or damage.
Do not infer mechanical seating solely from link recovery.
No automatic link reset, port reconfiguration or repeated physical cycle after failure.
agent_execution_scope: Capture pre-state mst/PCIe/link/fabric/BMC identity and health.
Provide timed markers for the operator cycle and collect complete transition events.
Verify the same expected device/link returns without new errors.
Report Tool Result without claiming mechanical acceptance or verdict.
engineer_actions: Approve outage and perform/record the cable plug cycle.
Judge connector ease, condition, latch and seating.
Review recovery evidence and issue PASS/FAIL.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Correctly supplementary, but `mst status -v / lspci` is only an example and may not cover a network/fabric cable's link state or traffic recovery.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Select read-only mst, PCIe, netdev or fabric commands according to the exact cable/endpoints, with pre/post identity and error deltas.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Ease of plug/unplug, one plug cycle, proper seating, post-cycle detection and 10/10-minute fields are preserved.

modernized_recommendation.status: MANUAL MECHANICAL CHECK WITH LINK CORRELATION
modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Use a cable/endpoint evidence card, operator close-up photos and synchronized fabric/link telemetry before, during and after reseating.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record adapter/switch firmware, driver/OFED and mst/fabric tool versions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Mellanox/NVIDIA cable installation and platform port map.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds traffic safety and exact recovery evidence without replacing mechanical judgment.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Link-up does not prove correct latch engagement or lack of connector damage.

project_override_considerations: The project defines the cable, cycle count and detection layer. Completion may claim only that specific path and approved interruption window.
expected_evidence: Cable/endpoint map, link role, outage approval and baseline health
Pre/post mst/PCIe/link/fabric identity plus event/error deltas
Final traffic/link/BMC health, Tool Result and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Procedure and criterion consistently cover mechanical plug/seating plus post-cycle detection. Missing exact component and detection layer are readiness inputs.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The intent is clear and manually executable once cable identity/outage/recovery are supplied.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Keeps manual classification while making its software examples topology-specific.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Agrees with MANUAL ONLY and retains its physical/link safety controls.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Separates mechanical acceptance, automated recovery evidence and engineer verdict.

review_improvement: Prevents mere device re-enumeration from being reported as proof of proper physical seating.
independent_technical_reasoning: The criteria concern a physical connection's fit and seating. Those require a person even though post-cycle device/link health is readily automatable.
no_automatic_retry: Do not reset the port, repeat the cycle or reconfigure fabric automatically after a detection/link failure. Preserve state for the owner.
